description: List documents in a group. Requires an API key with groups:read and documents:read. Paged; q searches title and file name (substring, case-insensitive).

folderId.description: Only documents filed in this folder.

q.description: Search text for title and file name.

rootOnly.description: true → only documents not in any folder.

sort.description: recent (default), oldest, name, name_desc, created or created_asc.

name: postmd_list_group_documents
